description: Every ModuleEngines/ModuleEnginesFX in the stock part cfgs. Modules are constructed with their real constructors, [KSPField]s are parsed by KSP's BaseFieldList.Load, FloatCurves by FloatCurve.Load; maxFuelFlow/minFuelFlow/throttleMin are the re-hosted OnLoad statements (ModuleEngines.cs:636-647). Thrust/Isp come from the real atmosphereCurve.Evaluate, MaxThrustOutputAtm, MaxThrustOutputVac, GetEngineThrust, getExhaustVelocity. Pressures are in atm (KSP evaluates atmosphereCurve in atm). The rocket_equation table re-hosts DeltaVStageInfo.StoreInterimDeltaV's dV expression for a single +Y engine (the stock VesselDeltaV simulation itself needs a full ShipConstruct and is capture-spec only).
oracles: rehosted: ModuleEngines.OnLoad maxFuelFlow/minFuelFlow/throttleMin; DeltaVStageInfo.StoreInterimDeltaV dV expression

provenance.float_semantics: IEEE-754 binary32/binary64, SSE2 (RyuJIT x64); libm from the .NET Framework CLR, not Unity's Mono

tables.name: isp_thrust_vs_pressure
tables.description: atmosphereCurve.Evaluate(p) and MaxThrustOutputAtm(runningActive=false, useThrustLimiter=true, atmPressure=p, atmTemp=310, atmDensity=1.225*p) with part.machNumber=0.

tables.name: kerbin_flight
tables.description: Engines in Kerbin atmosphere: altitude x mach (pressure/temperature/density from Kerbin's GetPressure/GetTemperature/GetDensity), MaxThrustOutputAtm with part.machNumber = mach (jets use atmCurve/velCurve).

tables.name: rocket_equation
tables.description: dV per DeltaVStageInfo.StoreInterimDeltaV (single engine, thrust vector +Y): |T_vec * (float)(ln(m0/m1) * isp * g0 / T)| with float masses.
